description: This source file provides implementations for managing an array of object identifiers (oids), including functions for appending, sorting, searching, filtering, and iterating over oids.

methods.name: void oid_array_append(struct oid_array * array,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Appends a new object ID to the array, optionally setting the algorithm if not already set, and marks the array as unsorted.

methods.name: void oid_array_sort(struct oid_array * array)
methods.description: Sorts the object ID array if it is not already sorted, using the qsort-based comparator.

methods.name: int oid_array_lookup(struct oid_array * array,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Performs a binary search for a given object ID in the array after ensuring it is sorted.

methods.name: void oid_array_clear(struct oid_array * array)
methods.description: Frees memory and resets the object ID array to an empty state.

methods.name: int oid_array_for_each(struct oid_array * array,for_each_oid_fn fn,void * data)
methods.description: Iterates over each object ID in the array, applying a callback function.

methods.name: int oid_array_for_each_unique(struct oid_array * array,for_each_oid_fn fn,void * data)
methods.description: Iterates over each unique object ID in the array, applying a callback function, ensuring no duplicates are processed.

methods.name: void oid_array_filter(struct oid_array * array,for_each_oid_fn want,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Filters the object IDs in the array based on a predicate function, removing those that do not satisfy the condition.

methods.name: const struct object_id * oid_access(size_t index,const void * table)
int void_hashcmp(const void * va,const void * vb)
